'''2009 US West Nationals Day 2 Peter Fratjord LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Peter Fratjord]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Peter Frafjord
* '''Deck name:''' The Old Switcharoo
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
